connector.name: SuprSend
connector.registryDescription: Manage SuprSend entities - workflows, templates, users, objects, tenants - from your AI assistant.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package suprsend. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the suprsend account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SUPRSEND_SERVICE_TOKEN
env.description: SuprSend service token. Create one in the SuprSend dashboard under Developers → API Keys.

env.name: SUPRSEND_BASE_URL
env.description: Base API URL. Only set for BYOC / self-hosted SuprSend instances.

env.name: SUPRSEND_MGMNT_URL
env.description: Management API URL. Only set for BYOC / self-hosted SuprSend instances.
